data_fields.name: window_last_date
data_fields.donor_constant: ed_year, ed_month, ed_day; 0 = unset (only a set end date can reach Ended)

data_fields.name: npc_fallback_window
data_fields.donor_constant: template StartTime and EndTime in hours (float); no window = always open

best_idea: One zone-event row (weekday, start and end minute, optional first and last date) gates a spawn group, and several rows on one spawner resolve by 'in progress beats ended beats not started'.
decision_why: Keep the row shape and the aggregate rule as zone data for timed invasions and events, but apply the time of day on every day the row covers, use one clock, and compute the next switch once per zone instead of one cron string per spawner.
acceptance: A zone row set to Friday 20:00 to 22:00 UTC with no date range opens its spawn group only between 20:00 and 22:00 each Friday: a server test asserts Friday 19:59 closed, 20:00 open, 21:59 open, 22:01 closed and Saturday 20:30 closed; a row with a last date reports Ended after that date and never reopens.
